answer_1.quote: We introduce MemeArena, a novel agent-driven evaluation framework that assesses mLLMs' capabilities to understand context-aware multimodal harmfulness in an arena-style fashion.
answer_1.outputs: context-specific analyses of meme harmfulness, multi-view fused guidelines, model rankings

answer_2.quote: We employ Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG), a standard ranking quality metric to quantify the evaluation biases in the assessment results.

answer_3.quote: judge agents from the evaluator panel are employed similarly to the LLM-as-a-Judge way, to determine which target mLLM provides a better analysis response for a given context-specific task.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations on 1) the quality of multi-view fused guidelines, 2) the diversity of simulated contexts, 3) the reliability of agent judgments.
answer_4.guideline: human experts to rate these results on the five aspects: Conciseness, Informativeness, Persuasiveness, Readability, Soundness
